# TechScript

> TechScript is the world's most beginner-friendly, plain-English programming language. Write code with natural keywords: `say`, `make`, `when`, `each`, `build`. Powered by a native Rust virtual machine.

## Key Links

- [Official Website](https://techscript.is-a.dev/)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Tcode-Motion/techscript)
- [Latest Releases & Download](https://github.com/Tcode-Motion/techscript/releases/latest)
- [Language Reference Docs](https://github.com/Tcode-Motion/techscript/blob/master/docs/REFERENCE.md)
- [Quick Start Guide](https://github.com/Tcode-Motion/techscript/blob/master/docs/QUICKSTART.md)
- [Web Module Docs](https://github.com/Tcode-Motion/techscript/blob/master/docs/WEB_MODULE.md)
- [Projects Showcase](https://techscript.is-a.dev/projects.html)

## Language Philosophy
- **Natural Language Readability**: Keywords form spoken English structures (e.g. `say "hello"`, `make score be 100`, `when age >= 18`).
- **No Punctuation Barriers**: Eliminates semicolons and brackets wherever practical to remove syntax friction for absolute beginners.
- **High Performance VM**: Compiles to bytecode and executes on a memory-safe, blazing-fast native Rust virtual machine.
- **Ecosystem Ready**: Ships with TechScript Studio IDE, a CLI toolchain (repl, transpile, check), and a ZeroHTML web builder.

## CLI Command toolchain
- `tech run <file.txs>`: Executes a TechScript source file.
- `tech repl`: Starts the interactive REPL.
- `tech check <file.txs>`: Validates syntax without executing.
- `tech transpile <file.txs>`: Transpiles TechScript source code into Python.
- `tech version`: Shows version information.

## Syntax Quick Reference

### Print to screen
```techscript
say "Hello, World!"
```

### Variables & Constants
```techscript
make x be 10
keep PI be 3.14159
```

### Conditionals
```techscript
when age >= 18 {
  say "Adult"
} or when age >= 13 {
  say "Teenager"
} else {
  say "Child"
}
```

### Loops
```techscript
each i in 1..5 {
  say f"Count: {i}"
}
```

### Functions
```techscript
build greet(name) {
  say f"Hello, {name}!"
}
```

### Classes (OOP)
```techscript
model Dog {
  build init(self, name) {
    self.name = name
  }
  build speak(self) {
    say f"{self.name}: Woof!"
  }
}
```

### Error Handling
```techscript
attempt {
  make x be 10 / 0
} catch err {
  say err.message
}
```
